final_document_md.description: Finalized digest document in Markdown format

final_metadata.description: Document-level structural metadata about the finalized digest

input_date.description: Anchor date of the digest (e.g. YYYY-MM-DD)

topic.description: Topic or title of the digest

highlight_count.description: Number of highlight entries in the digest

item_count.description: Number of regular item entries in the digest

has_summary.description: Whether the digest contains an overview/summary section

has_ending.description: Whether the digest contains a closing/ending section

formatting_version.description: Formatting version of the final document (e.g. v1)

carried_metadata.description: Optional metadata carried through from earlier pipeline stages
